Cluster 3 · Live Calculator, Fertigation & Petioles

Grape Fertilizer Schedule, Petiole Norms & Live Dose Calculator

Direct Answer · Grape Fertilizer & Fertigation Schedule

Maharashtra/Karnataka single-crop drip vineyards budget 180–266 kg N : 160–213 kg P₂O₅ : 240–320 kg K₂O/ha/yr (~108:72:135 g/vine @ 2,222/ha + 40–50 t/ha FYM), split 35% N / 45% P / 25% K in April and 65% N / 55% P / 75% K in October. Tamil Nadu double-crop Bowers use 150:100:350 g/vine per crop [ICAR-NRCG; TNAU].

Stage-Wise Drip Fertigation & Daily Irrigation Schedule (ICAR-NRCG)

Direct Answer · Grape Drip Irrigation & Stage Splits

Single-crop vines need 2,500–4,500 L/vine in April and 5,000–7,500 L/vine in October (~300–450 mm drip). Daily drip climbs from 6–10 L/vine/day at sprout (1–40 DAP) to 10–14 L at bloom/set (41–70 DAP) and 14–22 L at 6–16 mm sizing (71–110 DAP), tapering to 8–12 L at veraison (taper 7–10 d pre-pick) [ICAR-NRCG].

Water Salinity (ECw), Bicarbonate Acidification & Tank A/B Safety Locks

Direct Answer · Water Quality & Tank Incompatibility Rules

Keep irrigation water at ECw < 1.0 dS/m (>2.7 causes severe loss) and Cl⁻ ≤ 3 me/L own-rooted. Acidify high-bicarbonate water (HCO₃⁻ > 2.5–3.0 me/L) with controlled H₂SO₄ to pH 6.5, auto-block MOP under salinity, and isolate Ca(NO₃)₂ strictly in Tank B away from SO₄/PO₄ tanks [ICAR-NRCG; MANAGE].

Hard Guard · Tank A vs Tank B

Never Mix Calcium Nitrate with Sulphates or Phosphates

Keep Ca(NO₃)₂ strictly in Tank B. Keep MAP (12:61:00), MKP (0:52:34), SOP (0:0:50), and MgSO₄ in Tank A. Mixing them precipitates solid gypsum/calcium phosphate that permanently clogs 4 LPH inline emitters.

Hard Guard · Saline & Calcareous Fixes

Acidify pH 6.5 + Block Overhead Saline Sprinklers

Never overhead-sprinkle water with >100 ppm Cl, >70 ppm Na, or >1 ppm B. Apply 10–15 t/ha mulch + gypsum + compost on pH >8.0 soils, and use Fe-EDDHA (10–15 g/vine) for calcareous iron chlorosis. Seaweed/humic biostimulants help fine root flush alongside NPK, but never replace 110R or acidification [ICAR-NRCG].

Petiole Testing Norms (45 DAP April & October Full Bloom)

Direct Answer · Grape Petiole Nutrient Norms

Collect petioles at 45 DAP April (bud differentiation) and October full bloom to tune doses accurately. Optimum Thompson norms: N 1.0–1.5%, P 0.30–0.50%, K 1.5–2.5%, Ca 0.90–1.50%, Mg 0.30–0.60%, Zn & B 30–50 ppm, Fe 50–100 ppm. Toxicity flags: Na >0.40–0.50% or Cl >1.0–1.5% [ICAR-NRCG].

Verified Worked Examples (ICAR-NRCG & TNAU Math Audit)

Worked Example (a): 40 Gunthas (1 Acre) Nashik 110R Saline Drip

Setup: 3.0 × 1.5 m = 899 vines · ECw 1.6 (MOP blocked!) · HCO₃⁻ 3.2 (pH 6.5 acidification) · Soil N Med, P Low (+25%), K Med.

Annual Totals: 97.09 kg N · 80.91 kg P₂O₅ · 121.37 kg K₂O · 17,980 kg FYM.

April: 151.69 kg SSP, 23.35 kg MKP, 44.80 kg SOP, 73.87 kg Urea (52.76 / 10.54 / 10.57 kg).
October: 72.95 kg MAP, 50.58 kg KNO₃, 136.54 kg SOP, 103.87 kg Urea (stop N by 95–105 DAP).

Worked Example (b): 1 Acre TN Muscat / Anab-e-Shahi Double-Crop

Setup: 3.0 × 3.0 m = 450 vines · Medium Soil · ECw 0.6 (sweet water, MOP allowed).

Per-Crop Totals (150:100:350 g/vine): 67.50 kg N · 45.00 kg P₂O₅ · 157.50 kg K₂O · 13,500 kg FYM.

Per-Crop Products: 281.25 kg SSP (basal) · 262.50 kg MOP (131.25 kg @ 45 & 75 DAP) · 146.74 kg Urea (73.37 kg @ 15 & 45 DAP; zero past 75 DAP).

Fertilizer Schedule & Petiole Testing FAQs

What is the ICAR-NRCG annual NPK dose for single-crop Maharashtra & Karnataka grapes?

Single-crop drip vineyards budget 180–266 kg N, 160–213 kg P2O5, and 240–320 kg K2O per hectare per year (~108:72:135 g/vine/yr at 2,222 vines/ha) plus 40–50 t/ha FYM, split 35% N / 45% P / 25% K in April and 65% N / 55% P / 75% K in October [ICAR-NRCG; MPKV].

When should grape petioles be sampled and what are the toxicity red flags?

Sample petioles opposite the cluster at 45 DAP after April pruning and again at October full bloom. Optimum ranges: N 1.0–1.5%, P 0.30–0.50%, K 1.5–2.5%, Ca 0.90–1.50%, Mg 0.30–0.60%, Zn & B 30–50 ppm. Toxic alerts: Na > 0.40–0.50% or Cl > 1.0–1.5% [ICAR-NRCG].

Why must MOP (0:0:60) be blocked when water ECw >= 1.0 dS/m or Chloride > 3 me/L?

Muriate of Potash contains high chloride, which compounds borewell salinity, scorches leaf margins, and ruins export berry quality. Switch strictly to Chloride-free SOP (0:0:50) and Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) [ICAR-NRCG].

Why can Calcium Nitrate never be mixed in the same fertigation tank as SOP, MAP, or MKP?

Calcium reacts instantly with Sulphates (SOP, MgSO4) and Phosphates (MAP, MKP) to precipitate insoluble gypsum and calcium phosphate, clogging drip emitters and locking out nutrients. Always isolate Ca(NO3)2 in Tank B.
